data.one_liner: A tool to visualize package dependencies and version constraints in your Dart project.
data.what_it_does: Pubviz generates interactive visualizations of dependency graphs and version constraints for Dart and Flutter projects. It supports opening an interactive web UI, or printing raw GraphViz DOT and Mermaid flowchart formats to the command line.
use_when: You want to inspect or document the dependency tree of a Dart or Flutter project.
You need to identify outdated packages or visualize a Dart pub workspace graph.
avoid_when: You are looking for a library to manage package states or runtime code generation inside your application.
strengths: Provides both a local web UI and raw text export options (DOT and Mermaid).
Can check pub.dev for latest package versions and highlight outdated dependencies.
weaknesses: Requires external tools like GraphViz installed on your machine for certain image export formats.
data.setup_notes: Can be run directly via `dart run pubviz@` or installed globally with `dart install pubviz`.
